readout_source: AI visual inspection of the 16 matched pairs in the same-head near condition; only action clauses change their textual order. This is not a sequential diffusion/edit experiment.

examples.33/right-bottom: Original has two subjects and right finger covers white spot; swapped clauses produce three bodies and visible gap at the target.
examples.33/left-bottom: Original left finger stops short; swapping the same two clauses gives visible left-fingertip contact.
examples.35/left-bottom: Original places extra dot under left fingertip. With swapped clauses the right arm reaches the single center dot despite the instruction still assigning it to the left.
